# ServerHelper

**Category:** Misc  
**Aliases:** ServerHelper

## What it does

Automates server-specific chat commands and notifications, including teleport, auction, and event helpers.

Description basis: [source review](https://github.com/Pan4ur/ThunderHack-Recode/blob/49c76bcc5a5e4fbd12b06305c09f0c8fb76c510b/src/main/java/thunder/hack/features/modules/misc/ServerHelper.java). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
